detail.body: ## Overview `track_weights_loading` only diffs parameter names, so `qkv_proj.weight` counts as loaded once any one shard is written. A checkpoint missing every `v_proj` loads cleanly and serves uninitialized rows. Follow-up to #55911 agreed with @hmellor. ## Claims - A stacked parameter (`MergedColumnParallelLinear`, `QKVParallelLinear` and their subclasses) that received only some shards now fails at load, naming the parameter and the missing shard ids. - Same gate as the existing check (unquantized by default, `enable_weights_track` to force). Valid checkpoints are untouched. ## Validation `pytest tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_stacked_shard_tracking.py` → 7 passed. Qwen3-0.6B on H100, tensors deleted from the safetensors file, loaded via `LLM`: | Checkpoint | main | this PR | |---|---|---| | untouched | OK | OK | | all `v_proj` removed | loads, generates `!!!!!!!!` | `ValueError: Following weights were not initialized from checkpoint: {'model.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj.weight.v', …}` | | `layers.3.mlp.up_proj` removed | loads, wrong text | `ValueError: Following weights were not initialized from checkpoint: {'model.layers.3.mlp.gate_up_proj.weight.1'}` | No eval needed: weights of a valid checkpoint are bitwise unchanged. ## Details New base `StackedColumnParallelLinear`: each `weight_loader`/`weight_loader_v2` records the shard it wrote on the param, and `pop_missing_shards()` reports expected shards that never arrived, then clears the record so a later load is graded on its own. Shards with zero rows on the rank are never expected. The loader runs it after the existing name check. `shard_ids` is now the single declaration per class. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

detail.title: [Bugfix][Model Loader] Reject stacked weights that received only some shards

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""A stacked parameter that received only some of its shards must be reported.
+
+`track_weights_loading` diffs parameter names, so `qkv_proj.weight` counts as
+loaded once any one shard is written. These tests pin the shard-level check
+that closes that gap for `QKVParallelLinear` and `MergedColumnParallelLinear`.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import LoadConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import (
+    MergedColumnParallelLinear,
+    QKVParallelLinear,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.default_loader import DefaultModelLoader
+
+HIDDEN = 8
+HEAD = 2
+
+pytestmark = [pytest.mark.cpu_test, pytest.mark.usefixtures("dist_init")]
+
+
+def shard(shape: tuple[int, ...], shard_id) -> torch.Tensor:
+    weight = torch.ones(shape)
+    weight.shard_id = shard_id
+    return weight
+
+
+def load(layer: nn.Module, *weights: tuple[str, torch.Tensor]) -> set[str]:
+    return set(layer.load_weights(weights))
+
+
+def make_qkv(total_num_heads: int = 2) -> QKVParallelLinear:
+    return QKVParallelLinear(HIDDEN, HEAD, total_num_heads, total_num_kv_heads=1)
+
+
+Q = ("weight", shard((2 * HEAD, HIDDEN), "q"))
+K = ("weight", shard((HEAD, HIDDEN), "k"))
+V = ("weight", shard((HEAD, HIDDEN), "v"))
+
+
+def test_qkv_reports_shards_the_checkpoint_never_filled():
+    layer = make_qkv()
+    load(layer, Q)
+    assert layer.pop_missing_shards() == ["weight.k", "weight.v"]
+
+    load(layer, Q, K, V)
+    assert layer.pop_missing_shards() == []
+
+
+def test_qkv_stacked_on_disk_fills_every_shard():
+    layer = make_qkv()
+    load(layer, ("weight", torch.ones(4 * HEAD, HIDDEN)))
+    assert layer.pop_missing_shards() == []
+
+
+def test_record_is_per_load_so_a_reload_cannot_coast_on_the_first():
+    layer = make_qkv()
+    load(layer, Q, K, V)
+    assert layer.pop_missing_shards() == []
+
+    load(layer, K, V)
+    assert layer.pop_missing_shards() == ["weight.q"]
+
+
+def test_each_parameter_is_checked_on_its_own():
+    """A complete weight must not hide a bias that is missing a shard."""
+    layer = make_qkv()
+    load(layer, Q, K, V, ("bias", shard((2 * HEAD,), "q")))
+    assert layer.pop_missing_shards() == ["bias.k", "bias.v"]
+
+
+def test_shard_with_no_rows_is_never_expected():
+    """Cross-attention kv_proj is a QKV layer with zero query heads."""
+    layer = make_qkv(total_num_heads=0)
+    load(layer, K, V)
+    assert layer.pop_missing_shards() == []
+
+
+def test_unknown_shard_id_is_rejected():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="should be one of"):
+        make_qkv().validate_shard_id("x")
+
+
+def test_merged_column_tuple_shard_is_one_span():
+    layer = MergedColumnParallelLinear(HIDDEN, [4, 4, 4], bias=False)
+    load(layer, ("weight", shard((8, HIDDEN), (0, 1))))
+    assert layer.pop_missing_shards() == ["weight.2"]
+
+    load(
+        layer, ("weight", shard((8, HIDDEN), (0, 1))), ("weight", shard((4, HIDDEN), 2))
+    )
+    assert layer.pop_missing_shards() == []
+
+
+def test_loader_lists_missing_shards_as_weights_not_loaded():
+    model = nn.Module()
+    model.layer = nn.Module()
+    model.layer.qkv_proj = make_qkv()
+    loaded = {f"layer.qkv_proj.{name}" for name in load(model.layer.qkv_proj, Q)}
+
+    loader = DefaultModelLoader(LoadConfig())
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="not initialized from checkpoint") as exc:
+        loader.track_weights_loading(model, loaded)
+    assert "'layer.qkv_proj.weight.k'" in str(exc.value)
+    assert "'layer.qkv_proj.weight.v'" in str(exc.value)

+class StackedColumnParallelLinear(ColumnParallelLinear):
+    """Column-parallel linear whose weight is several checkpoint tensors stacked
+    along the output dimension, each addressed by a shard id.
+
+    Keeps track of which shards a load delivered to each parameter so the loader
+    can reject a parameter that was only partly filled.
+    """
+
+    shard_ids: tuple[str | int, ...]
+    """Every shard this layer can receive."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        self.loaded_shard_ids: dict[str, set[str | int]] = {}
+
+    def _get_shard_size_mapping(self, loaded_shard_id: Any) -> int | None:
+        """Rows of this rank's parameter that belong to the shard."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def validate_shard_id(self, shard_id: Any, param: Parameter | None = None) -> bool:
+        """Check `shard_id` names shards of this layer and, if `param` is given,
+        record them as loaded into it."""
+        if shard_id is None:
+            # Already stacked on disk, so one tensor fills every shard.
+            shards = self.shard_ids
+        elif isinstance(shard_id, tuple):
+            shards = shard_id
+        else:
+            shards = (shard_id,)
+        if any(shard not in self.shard_ids for shard in shards):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Shard id for {type(self).__name__} should be one of "
+                f"{self.shard_ids}, got shard id {shard_id}."
+            )
+        if param is not None:
+            name = next((n for n, p in self.named_parameters() if p is param), None)
+            if name is not None:
+                self.loaded_shard_ids.setdefault(name, set()).update(shards)
+        return True
+
+    def pop_missing_shards(self) -> list[str]:
+        """`<param>.<shard>` for each shard this load never filled, then forget
+        the record so the next load starts fresh.
+
+        A shard with no rows on this rank is never expected, and a parameter
+        nothing was loaded into is left to the loader's parameter-level check.
+        """
+        loaded, self.loaded_shard_ids = self.loaded_shard_ids, {}
+        return [
+            f"{name}.{shard}"
+            for name, shards in loaded.items()
+            for shard in self.shard_ids
+            if shard not in shards and self._get_shard_size_mapping(shard)
+        ]
+
+
